profile.headline: Software Developer In Test at MatrixCare

positions.title: Software Developer In Test
positions.description:
Visual Studio/C#/Selenium/NUnit/Xamarin/AzureDevOps
- Sole developer refactoring/redesigning existing web app UI test project
- Initial developer orchestrating/designing/implementing new mobile app UI test project
- Implemented test data generator for manual and automation test isolation to meet critical deadline
- Instructed and documented proper git workflow for test source code repositories
- Assisted manual tester to become competent reading/writing/refactoring/executing automation tests

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Eclipse/Java/Tomcat/JavaScript/PostgreSQL/SourceTree
- Sole QA for internal greenfield project creating an automated unit and integration test suite
- Introduced and enhanced security of web application according to OWASP resources
- Implemented dynamic data export and download from relational database to Excel workbook
- Automated QA testing for website using Geb and Spock frameworks
- Verified and documented bug-fixes and new bugs in VS TeamFoundationServer

positions.title: Software QA Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for design, implementation and maintenance of test automation. Works with
developers and QA Leads to determine product and project specifications to determine what should be automated.Formulates automation plans and process to increase quality and improve implementation efficiencies.

• Create a framework for use by QA Shared Services
• Create, update and maintain automation suites and other testing
tools as needed for use by QA Shared Services.
• Produce test documentation including bug reports and test
summaries.
• Work with QA group on proper use of automation tools and provide
training.

positions.title: Runner
positions.description:
Created desktop applications to assist in car accident solicitation mailings using C# in Visual Studio
and a command line app that parses a scanned in index card and formats it’s data into an excel file.

positions.title: Forestry Technician
positions.description: Completed timber cruising/timber sale marking, research measurements, streamside management zone/boundary marking, GIS mapping (aerial image/ground-truthing vegetation cover types and boundaries) writing forest management plans.

positions.title: Work Crew
positions.description: -Measured diameter and height of study trees in Hoffman Forest

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: -Conducted self-directed natural resource assessment for Town of Holly Springs on Bass Lake Park

positions.title: Farm Hand
positions.description:
-Culled peaches, customer service, miscellaneous farm jobs
-Learned how to run a farm and forest management practices and applied this to pine farms I currently
help manage.
